managed.heading: Managed cloud pods
managed.sub: We run them - billed per second, scale-to-zero when idle. A small margin over raw cloud, so there's no capacity for you to manage.
managed.note: Suspended pods bill storage only (~$0.10/GB-month). Regions across AWS, GCP, Hetzner & Fly.io. Team seats include 60 pod-hours/developer each month.

byo.heading: Bring your own compute
byo.sub: Point poddle at your own cloud account or self-hosted runners. You pay your infrastructure provider directly - poddle only charges the per-developer broker fee.
feats: Your cloud or on-prem, your region
Data and compute stay in your account

included: No vendor secret inside the pod

faqs.a: Anyone in your org who spins up or drives a pod. Read-only viewers of an audit trail are free.

faqs.q: Do I pay poddle for compute?
faqs.a: Only for managed pods - metered at a small margin over raw cloud, billed per second with scale-to-zero when idle. Bring your own cloud or self-hosted compute and you pay that provider directly; poddle just brokers the credentials.

Yes. poddle is open source - run the broker on your own infrastructure and the raw secret stays in a vault you control. Most teams pick the managed cloud so there is no control plane to operate; the guarantees are identical either way.

faqs.q: Is there a trial for Team?
faqs.a: Yes - 14 days, no card. Your pods and identities carry straight over if you keep going.
